title: Prit, Dua Ribu
mood: deadpan fury you can dance to
subject: the parking attendant who appears from nowhere to whistle you out of a minimarket lot and charge two thousand rupiah
caption: Indonesian electro post-punk in the Central Java DIY protest style. A drum machine playing a straight motorik eighth-note kick and snare with a dry clap, a distorted and chorused bass riff as the main hook, an angular, trebly clean electric guitar repeating a two-note figure, and a cheap analog synth riff doubling the bass in the chorus. Raw and dry, mid-forward, with the bass and the shouted voice on top and almost no reverb. Shouted, deadpan female lead vocal chanting slogan lines, with a mixed crowd shouting the answers. 142 BPM, E minor. Deadpan fury you can dance to. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no autotune, no melodic pop chorus, no funkot kicks, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - drum machine and bass riff]

[Verse 1]
Aku masuk minimarket, nggak ada siapa-siapa
Beli air mineral, tiga ribu lima ratus
Aku keluar, motor baru mau mundur
Dari balik tiang listrik ada peluit bunyi

[Chorus - crowd answers]
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Datang nggak kelihatan, pulang minta duit
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Motorku nggak dijaga, cuma ditiupin

[Verse 2]
Dia nggak bantu nyeberang, dia nggak bantu mundur
Dia main HP di balik tiang listrik dari tadi
Tulisan di pintu "Parkir gratis" warnanya biru
Peluitnya lebih keras dari tulisannya

[Chorus - crowd answers]
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Datang nggak kelihatan, pulang minta duit
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Airku tiga ribu lima, parkirnya dua ribu

[Bridge - drum machine and voice only]
Aku kasih koin, dia nggak bilang makasih
Besok aku jalan kaki
Besok dia tetap di situ

[Outro - bass riff alone]
Prit.

[Song ends abruptly]
